epigraph: The spire holds the fire that burns the world true.
vignette: The Ember Spire stands on the edge of the Rift. It is black stone and hot iron. Heat rises from the cracks in the walls. The Umbral people gather at the base. They bring fuel. They burn wood and bone. The fire feeds the stone. The stone holds the line. A Verdant soldier steps onto the plaza. He tries to write a root into the ground. The heat drives him back. The ground refuses the green. The fire wins. The soldier retreats. The Spire remains. It is the anchor. If the Spire falls the Umbral drains away. The cities go dark. The appetite dies. The soldiers know this. They guard the stone. They feed the flame. The Rift leaks motes nearby. The Spire burns them away. The truth of the Umbral is fire. The truth of the Spire is persistence. It stands while the world burns around it.
codex_note: The Ember Spire is the sole structural anchor for Umbral reality in Limen, and its destruction would cause the immediate evaporation of Umbral influence from the threshold.
